card.name: Last word of company or institute names
card.fires_on: The final word of an organization name, such as Software, Martin, Dynamics, Healthcare, Microsystems or Research. It also fires on the verb or apostrophe right after a company name.

modes.label: Just after company name
modes.description: The verb or possessive mark directly following a company name.
